Akshay Kumar Discusses Anil Kapoor and Nana Patekar's Potential Return for 'Welcome 4'

Actor Akshay Kumar has indicated that Anil Kapoor and Nana Patekar would return for 'Welcome 4' if the film is made. Kumar referred to Kapoor and Patekar as 'family', suggesting an open invitation for their participation. This statement addresses the potential cast for a future installment of the 'Welcome' film series. The news focuses on the casting prospects for a popular Bollywood franchise.
